lede: The week's most consequential item lands Tuesday, June 30, when Town Council takes up first reading of Land Use Code amendments tied to Colorado's new wildfire resilience requirements — building rules that hit close to home for anyone living at the bottom of a box canyon. The same night, the Telluride Housing Authority appoints members to its new Resident Advisory Committee, drawing from fifteen tenant applications across Town properties. Out on the Valley Floor Monday afternoon, the Open Space Commission walks Reach 1 to weigh actual river trail alignments on the ground.
